title: Critical UI Fix: Restore Button Visibility (White-on-White Bug)

requirements.text: Force all primary action buttons across the entire app (including 'Sign In', 'Place Order', 'Place Recharge Order', 'Add to Cart', 'Checkout', and any other CTA buttons) to use a solid #0056b3 background with bold white (#ffffff) text. Override any conflicting Tailwind utility classes or CSS custom properties that are currently rendering buttons with white or near-white backgrounds.

quotes: Force Button Colors: Set all buttons to a Solid Blue (#0056b3) background with Bold White text.

acceptanceCriteria: All primary action buttons display a solid #0056b3 blue background.
All button labels are clearly legible with white text.
No button is invisible or blends into a white/light background.
Fix applies consistently across HomePage, CheckoutPage, OrderConfirmationPage, MobileRechargeSection, ProductCard, CartDrawer, and all other pages with buttons.

requirements.text: Fix the Header component so that the 'Logout' and 'Cart' (with item count badge) buttons are clearly visible against the header background. Ensure these buttons have sufficient color contrast — use #0056b3 fill or a visually distinct outlined style with white/dark text so they are never invisible.

quotes: Header Fix: Make sure the 'Logout' and 'Cart' buttons are clearly visible against the header.

acceptanceCriteria: 'Logout' button in Header is visible and has readable text.
'Cart' icon button in Header is visible with its item count badge clearly displayed.
Both buttons pass basic contrast requirements against the header background.

requirements.text: Restore the Sign-In page (Internet Identity login screen) so that all buttons — including the 'Sign In' / 'Login' button — are NOT white. Apply the same #0056b3 solid background with white bold text. Ensure the button is clearly clickable and visually prominent on the page.

quotes: Sign-In Restoration: Ensure the Sign-In page buttons are NOT white. They must be easily clickable.

acceptanceCriteria: Sign-In page renders with a clearly visible login button in #0056b3 with white text.
The button is not white, transparent, or blended into the background.
User can identify and click the Sign-In button without any confusion.

requirements.text: Fix the category filter buttons in the CategoryFilter component so they are rendered with a visible background and legible label text. Selected/active category buttons should use #0056b3 with white text; unselected buttons should use a light gray background with dark text — ensuring none are invisible.

quotes: All buttons (Sign In, Categories, Place Order) are currently invisible (White on White).

acceptanceCriteria: All category filter buttons are visible with readable labels.
Active/selected category button is highlighted in #0056b3 with white text.
Unselected category buttons use a clearly visible style distinct from the page background.

requirements.text: Audit and fix the global CSS custom properties and Tailwind theme in frontend/src/index.css and frontend/tailwind.config.js to ensure that no --primary, --background, or button-related CSS variables resolve to white or near-white values that cause buttons to disappear. Set --primary to #0056b3 and --primary-foreground to #ffffff in the light theme token definitions.
acceptanceCriteria: CSS custom property --primary resolves to #0056b3 (or equivalent) in light theme.
No button component inherits a white-on-white style from the theme tokens.
Dark mode tokens, if defined, also maintain readable button contrast.

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui.
Do not change backend logic, data models, or Motoko files.
Button color fix must be applied globally — do not patch only one page or component in isolation.
nonGoals: Fixing the 'Place Recharge Order' backend linkage (separate issue).
Fixing the Admin Panel shop status 'Reverting to Open' bug (separate issue).
Adding new features (search, wallet, invoice QR code, WhatsApp share).
Dark mode redesign beyond fixing contrast tokens.
